lines.t: I love elephants because they are strong and clever.
lines.zh: 我喜欢大象，因为它们强壮又聪明。

lines.t: They are also a symbol of good luck here.
lines.zh: 在这里它们也是好运的象征。

lines.t: The elephant is our national animal.
On 13 March, we celebrate Thai Elephant Day.
Elephants look very different from other animals.
lines.zh: 大象看起来和别的动物很不一样。

lines.t: They have large ears and long trunks.
lines.zh: 它们有大耳朵和长鼻子。

lines.t: They can pick up and carry heavy things with their trunks.
lines.zh: 它们能用鼻子拿起并搬运重物。

lines.t: Elephants are like us in some ways.
lines.zh: 大象在某些方面和我们很像。

lines.t: They are very playful and love to play in the water.
lines.zh: 它们非常爱玩，喜欢在水里嬉戏。

lines.t: For example, they can remember one another and places with food and water after many years.
lines.zh: 例如，许多年后它们还能记得彼此，记得有食物和水的地方。

lines.t: They look after other elephants when they don't feel well.
lines.zh: 当别的大象不舒服时，它们会照顾它们。

lines.t: The big elephants also help the baby ones.
Elephants are an important part of Thai life and culture.
lines.zh: 大象是泰国人生活和文化的重要部分。
然而，它们正处于危险之中。

lines.t: They live in forests, but people cut down too many trees.
lines.zh: 它们生活在森林里，但人们砍伐了太多树木。

lines.t: People also kill elephants for their ivory.
lines.zh: 人们还为了象牙杀害大象。

lines.t: Let's save the forests and not buy things made of ivory.
lines.zh: 让我们保护森林，不买象牙制品。

lines.t: Many people are rushing to the subway.
Bright yellow taxis are picking up and dropping off passengers.
lines.zh: 亮黄色的出租车正在接送乘客。

lines.t: Some people are jogging, walking, and riding bikes in Central Park.
lines.zh: 有些人正在中央公园里慢跑、散步、骑自行车。

lines.t: Others are drinking coffee and eating breakfast in coffee shops.
lines.zh: 另一些人在咖啡馆里喝咖啡、吃早饭。

lines.t: Let's look at the weather across Australia.
lines.zh: 我们来看看澳大利亚各地的天气。

lines.t: It's raining and the wind is blowing hard.
In the west, it's cloudy and about 22°C.
In the south and east, the sun is shining and it's very hot.
lines.zh: 南部和东部阳光明媚，非常炎热。

lines.t: The centre of the country has the best weather right now.
lines.zh: 目前全国中部的天气最好。

lines.t: It's warm and dry, and the temperature is about 28°C.
lines.zh: 温暖干燥，气温大约28摄氏度。

lines.t: Hi, Lucy. It's raining cats and dogs.
lines.zh: 嗨，露西。正下着倾盆大雨。

lines.t: What's the weather like back home?
I'm watering flowers in the garden.
I'm always happy, rain or shine!
lines.zh: 无论晴雨，我总是很开心！

lines.t: I'm at a beach in Sanya!
What are you doing at the beach?
He's playing beach volleyball right now.
lines.zh: 他此刻正在打沙滩排球。
斯德哥尔摩天气怎么样？

lines.t: Well, we usually stay in when it snows, but now we're building a snowman outside.
lines.zh: 嗯，下雪时我们通常待在家里，但现在我们在外面堆雪人。

lines.t: Hey, come and visit us some day!
Hey, Anna. How's your holiday going?
lines.zh: 嘿，安娜，你的假期过得怎么样？

lines.t: I'm at a beach in Sanya!
What are you doing at the beach?
He's playing beach volleyball right now.
lines.zh: 他此刻正在打沙滩排球。
斯德哥尔摩天气怎么样？

lines.t: Well, we usually stay in when it snows, but now we're building a snowman outside.
lines.zh: 嗯，下雪时我们通常待在家里，但现在我们在外面堆雪人。

lines.t: Hey, come and visit us some day!
Are they visiting the same place?
lines.zh: 他们在游览同一个地方吗？

lines.t: Do they feel the same about it?
lines.zh: 他们对这个地方的感受一样吗？

lines.t: It feels like a magical place.
lines.zh: 这里感觉像一个神奇的地方。

lines.t: The trees and rocks look like a part of a painting.
lines.zh: 树木和岩石看起来像一幅画的一部分。

lines.t: We're at a rest area now.
Climbing is hard, but we're making good progress.
lines.zh: 爬山很难，但我们进展很顺利。

lines.t: Although the weather is bad, many people here are still in high spirits.
lines.zh: 虽然天气不好，这里的许多人依然兴致很高。

lines.t: I don't think my brother Peter is enjoying the experience very much, so I'm encouraging him.
lines.zh: 我觉得我弟弟彼得不太喜欢这次经历，所以我在鼓励他。

lines.t: The sun is shining through the clouds!
I'm so glad we're here at Bright Peak.
lines.zh: 我真高兴我们来到了光明顶。
海伦 5月1日10:36 爬山真累！

lines.t: Today I'm visiting Mount Huangshan with my family.
lines.zh: 今天我和家人在游览黄山。

lines.t: I'm not really enjoying the experience.
Everything looks grey, and you can't see much because of the heavy fog.
lines.zh: 一切看起来都是灰色的，因为大雾你看不清多少东西。

lines.t: The ground is very wet, so we have to climb
lines.zh: 地面很湿，所以我们只能慢慢地爬

lines.t: My shoes are all wet and dirty too.
lines.zh: 我的鞋也全湿了，还很脏。

lines.t: There are many other tourists at this rest area, but they don't seem tired at all.
lines.zh: 这个休息区还有很多其他游客，但他们看起来一点也不累。

lines.t: My sister Helen is also in high spirits.
lines.zh: 我姐姐海伦也兴高采烈的。

lines.t: Peter 9:15 1 May Today I'm visiting Mount Huangshan with my family.
lines.zh: 彼得 5月1日9:15 今天我和家人在游览黄山。

lines.t: Mount Huangshan is beautiful in the sunlight.
I'm tired and hungry, but it feels good to be at the top!
lines.zh: 我又累又饿，但到达山顶感觉真好！
你看到什么有趣的东西了吗？

lines.t: There were some special rooms, and they looked like parts of a space station.
lines.zh: 有一些特别的房间，看起来像空间站的一部分。

lines.t: You could go inside them and see how astronauts live and work!
lines.zh: 你可以走进去，看看航天员是怎样生活和工作的！

lines.t: I asked one of them questions and it answered me!
lines.zh: 我问了其中一个机器人问题，它回答了我！

lines.t: I'd love to go and see them!
How was your weekend, Teng Fei?
lines.zh: 滕飞，你周末过得怎么样？

lines.t: Well, first, I was on my way to meet my friends when some tourists asked me the way to the history museum.
lines.zh: 嗯，首先，我在去见朋友的路上，有几个游客问我去历史博物馆怎么走。

lines.t: I didn't mean to, but I gave them the wrong directions.
lines.zh: 我不是故意的，但我给他们指错了路。

lines.t: I only realized it after they left!
lines.zh: 他们走了以后我才意识到！

lines.t: They probably asked someone else too.
I even got on the wrong bus.
I was late to meet my friends.
Oh, and I left my book on the bus too!
lines.zh: 哦，我还把书落在公交车上了！
你看到什么有趣的东西了吗？

lines.t: How was your school trip to the wastewater plant?
lines.zh: 你们学校去污水处理厂的游学怎么样？

lines.t: We saw the plant make dirty water clean again.
lines.zh: 我们看到工厂把脏水重新变干净。

lines.t: Well, first, dirty water from our homes goes into the plant.
lines.zh: 嗯，首先，我们家里的脏水流进工厂。

lines.t: Then, special screens remove large pieces of waste from the water.
lines.zh: 然后，特殊的滤网把大块的废弃物从水中除去。

lines.t: Well, large machines remove germs and other things from the water.
lines.zh: 嗯，大型机器除去水里的细菌和其他东西。

lines.t: These things are usually too small to see.
lines.zh: 这些东西通常太小，看不见。

lines.t: It takes a few more steps after that before the water becomes clean again.
lines.zh: 那之后还要经过好几个步骤，水才会重新变干净。

lines.t: Wow! I used to think it was easy to get clean water.
lines.zh: 哇！我过去以为得到干净的水很容易。

lines.t: I didn't realize it was so hard.

Today we went on a school trip to a farm!
lines.zh: 今天我们学校组织去一个农场游学！

lines.t: It was tiring but great fun!
In the morning, we explored the farm.
There were large tents with tomatoes, cucumbers, and many other fruits and vegetables.
lines.zh: 那里有大棚，里面种着西红柿、黄瓜和许多其他蔬菜水果。

lines.t: The farmer told us about how these fruits and vegetables go from the fields to our tables.
lines.zh: 农民给我们讲了这些蔬菜水果是怎样从田间来到我们餐桌上的。

lines.t: I was very interested because I usually only see them in the supermarket.
lines.zh: 我非常感兴趣，因为我平时只在超市里见到它们。

lines.t: Then we got straight to work!
lines.zh: 然后我们就直接开始干活了！
首先，我们摘了一些草莓。

lines.t: The work seemed easy, but it took time to get it right.
lines.zh: 这活儿看起来很容易，但要做好需要时间。
慢慢地，我们装满了好多篮子。

lines.t: In the afternoon, the farmer taught us how to cut branches and leaves from tomato plants.
lines.zh: 下午，农民教我们怎样从西红柿秧上剪掉枝叶。

lines.t: This helps them to grow more fruit.
lines.zh: 这能帮助它们结更多的果实。
最后，我们给植物浇了水。
种植物要付出这么多劳动！

lines.t: It was tiring, but I enjoyed working with my hands.
lines.zh: 很累，但我喜欢动手劳动。

lines.t: One thing I learnt today: Farming isn't easy!
lines.zh: 我今天学到了一件事：种地不容易！

lines.t: It made me think of the saying,"Every grain comes from hard work."The
lines.zh: 它让我想起了那句话：“粒粒皆辛苦。”

lines.t: work."The farmer let us take some vegetables home.
lines.zh: 农民让我们带了一些蔬菜回家。

lines.t: My mum cooked some for dinner, and they were fresh and delicious!
lines.zh: 妈妈做了一些当晚饭，它们又新鲜又好吃！

lines.t: They certainly taste better when you work for them!
lines.zh: 自己动手劳动得来的东西，吃起来肯定更香！

lines.t: Today was really a day to remember.
Please share your favourite story with me, Peter.
lines.zh: 彼得，请和我分享你最喜欢的故事。

lines.t: Once a lion caught a mouse.
lines.zh: 有一次，一头狮子抓住了一只老鼠。

lines.t: One day I will help you!"
The lion laughed and let the mouse go.
Later, a hunter caught the lion in a net.
lines.zh: 后来，一个猎人用网抓住了狮子。

lines.t: The mouse helped the lion then.
He bit through the net and set the lion free!
lines.zh: 他咬破了网，放走了狮子！

lines.t: What's your favourite story, Teng Fei?
lines.zh: 滕飞，你最喜欢的故事是什么？

lines.t: Later, his horse came back with seven other horses.
lines.zh: 后来，他的马带着另外七匹马回来了。

lines.t: Later, his son broke his leg when he tried to ride a horse.
lines.zh: 后来，他的儿子骑马时摔断了腿。

lines.t: Well, because of his leg, the son didn't have to join a war.
lines.zh: 嗯，因为腿伤，儿子不用去打仗了。

lines.t: Unlucky things may turn out well.
And good things could go wrong too.

lines.t: Here's The Emperor's New Clothes by Hans Christian Andersen.
lines.zh: 这是汉斯·克里斯蒂安·安徒生的《皇帝的新装》。

lines.t: Once upon a time, an emperor liked clothes very much.
lines.zh: 从前，有个皇帝非常喜欢衣服。

lines.t: He wanted to buy some new clothes.
Two brothers came and lied to him,
lines.zh: 两兄弟来了，对他撒谎说：

lines.t: "We can make wonderful clothes! But only clever people can see them!"
lines.zh: “我们能做出很棒的衣服！可是只有聪明的人才能看见它们！”

lines.t: They pretended to make the clothes.
The emperor's officials couldn't see the clothes, but they said, "What lovely clothes!"
lines.zh: 皇帝的大臣们看不见衣服，但他们说：“多漂亮的衣服啊！”

lines.t: The emperor couldn't see anything either, but he said, "They're beautiful!"
lines.zh: 皇帝也什么都看不见，但他说：“它们真美！”

lines.t: No one wanted to look silly.
The emperor decided to show everyone his new clothes.
lines.zh: 皇帝决定向大家展示他的新衣服。

lines.t: People in the street praised them.
lines.zh: 街上的人们都称赞它们。

lines.t: They were afraid to look silly too!
Suddenly, a boy shouted, "Look! The emperor has no clothes on!"
lines.zh: 突然，一个男孩喊道：“看！皇帝什么也没穿！”

lines.t: Please tell me what you think.

Once upon a time, there was a mother duck.
Five of the ducklings were small and yellow, but the last duckling was big and grey.
lines.zh: 五只小鸭子又小又黄，但最后一只小鸭子又大又灰。

lines.t: At the river, the ugly duckling swam well, just like all the other ducklings.
lines.zh: 在河里，丑小鸭和其他小鸭子一样游得很好。

lines.t: But the other ducklings still laughed at him and told him to go away.
lines.zh: 但其他小鸭子还是嘲笑他，叫他走开。

lines.t: It made the poor duckling very sad, so he decided to search for a new home.
lines.zh: 这让可怜的小鸭非常难过，所以他决定去寻找一个新家。

lines.t: He met many other birds, but all of them thought that he was ugly too.
lines.zh: 他遇到了许多别的鸟，但它们都觉得他也很丑。

lines.t: They did not want him to live with them.
lines.zh: 它们不想让他和它们住在一起。

lines.t: One day, the duckling met a cat and a hen.
lines.zh: 有一天，小鸭子遇见了一只猫和一只母鸡。

lines.t: But the two animals said no.
They did not like him because he could not purr or lay eggs!
lines.zh: 它们不喜欢他，因为他不会打呼噜，也不会下蛋！

lines.t: Some days later, the ugly duckling came to a lake.
lines.zh: 几天后，丑小鸭来到一个湖边。

lines.t: There, he saw three beautiful swans with long necks and white feathers.
lines.zh: 在那里，他看见三只美丽的天鹅，长着长脖子和白羽毛。

lines.t: "My friend, you do look like us!
lines.zh: “我的朋友，你确实长得像我们！

lines.t: The duckling looked down, and to his surprise, he saw that he was a beautiful white swan too!
lines.zh: 小鸭子往下一看，惊讶地发现自己也是一只美丽的白天鹅！
